info.name: SprintLabs Students - Seeded Repeatable Tests
info.description: Run all requests in order. Fresh UUID CSV data is generated without local file selection; enrollments created by this run are revoked at cleanup. No seeded student is revoked. XLSX export runs automatically. Optional XLSX upload requires a prepared local file; see README. Tokens remain run-local; never export response logs. Requires two free student seats (four when optional XLSX tests run).

item.name: 01. Login owner and generate fresh run data

exec: const password=pm.variables.get('seedPassword'); if(!password){pm.test('Configure seedPassword locally',()=>{throw new Error('seedPassword is blank');});pm.execution.setNextRequest(null);pm.execution.skipRequest();}
const valid=pm.response.code===200 && data && typeof data.accessToken==='string' && data.community && data.community.name==='SprintLabs Demo School' && data.role==="CommunityAdmin";
